## Choose the expansion (2) {#check-two}

Expand $(3x-4)(3x+4)$. Identify the pattern on paper, then choose the matching expansion.

<div class="index-check" role="group" aria-label="Choose the expanded expression">

<button type="button" data-choice="a" aria-pressed="false">A. $9x^2-16$</button>
<button type="button" data-choice="b" aria-pressed="false">B. $9x^2-24x+16$</button>
<button type="button" data-choice="c" aria-pressed="false">C. $3x^2-16$</button>
<button type="button" data-choice="d" aria-pressed="false">D. $9x^2+16$</button>

</div>

<div class="check-feedback" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true">
<div data-result="a" hidden>

**Correct.** The terms match and the signs differ. Use $(a-b)(a+b)=a^2-b^2$.

$(3x-4)(3x+4)=(3x)^2-4^2=9x^2-16$. The cross products $12x$ and $-12x$ cancel.

</div>
<div data-result="b" hidden>

That expansion fits two identical brackets. Check the sign in the second bracket. What happens to the cross products? Try again.

</div>
<div data-result="c" hidden>

You squared the variable. Square the coefficient too: $(3x)^2=(3x)(3x)$. Try again.

</div>
<div data-result="d" hidden>

Check the last product. One bracket contains $-4$ and the other contains $+4$. Multiply them and try again.

</div>
</div>

<button class="reset-check" type="button" hidden>Try again from the start</button>
